company.summary: NORGES IDRETTSFORBUND OG OLYMPISKE OG PARALYMPISKE KOMITÉ is a association (forening/lag/innretning) in aktiviteter i idrettslag og -klubber (NACE 93.120), based in Oslo, founded 1991-05-15. Registered activity: Frivillig organisasjon. Latest filed accounts (2025-01-01 to 2025-12-31, company accounts): revenue NOK 3.1 bn, operating result NOK -17.9 m, net result NOK 1.1 m, total assets NOK 1.2 bn, equity NOK 93.2 m. The period closed with a profit. Registered employees: 440. Leadership in the official register: Kjell Bjarne Helland (Managing director); Zaineb Al-Samarai (Chair of the board); Sebastian Hansen Henriksen (Board member); Astrid Strandbu (Board member); plus 12 further roles. 37 registered workplaces in Arendal, Bardufoss, Bergen, Bodø, Drammen, Førde and more. Most recent registry event: Registered employee count updated (2026-10-13). Not established from checked sources: verified website (not available); website description (not available); company-owned social profiles (not available); active job ads (not available).
